description: This Java class defines the Employee entity for a persistence layer, including properties, getters/setters, equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: Employee
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee with properties for ID, first name, surname, role, and associated projects, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Returns the set of projects associated with the employee.

methods.name: setProjects
methods.description: Sets the set of projects associated with the employee.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare employee instances based on id, firstname, surname, and role.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on id, firstname, surname, and role.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Employee object.
